widgets_values:
# Reference-to-video - Standard

## Purpose
Generate video and audio guided by reference images, video or audio.

## Use
1. Load your reference media in the input nodes.
2. Write the scene, action and audio prompt.
3. Set output size, duration and seed, then run the workflow and review the result.

Workflow: r2v-pod.json
